headline: Corning (NYSE:GLW) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates, Stock Drops 16.1%
summary: Glass and electronic component manufacturer Corning (NYSE:GLW) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 11.4% year on year to $4.51 billion.
